items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Barry Galbraith? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. It was a nice . . .”wow” I said, “look at that.”

ctx.x: I don’t think so. [Laughs] or if I did it was probably a strange solo. In one other situation, I think that’s in the book, I actually did not play a note for thirty-two bars. I was stoned and I was just fascinated by the rhythm section with the guitar player, you know?
Yeah. It was a nice . . .”wow” I said, “look at that.” Finally, I took a bow just to do my “hammy” thing: That was one of my better solos.
